subject: Proposal: Runtime team seniority & reporting redesign — comms + HR steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Leadership <leadership@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Runtime team seniority & reporting redesign — comms + HR steps

Team —

As discussed in last week's leadership sync, attached is a concrete proposal to reorganize the Runtime engineering org into two reporting clusters: Core Runtime (model-serving, compilation, kernels) and Edge Runtime (on-device, light-weight inference, latency-optimized variants). This note outlines the structure, manager/reporting changes, and an initial comms + HR path for sensitive moves (promotions, lateral moves, and one potential role consolidation).

Top-level ask: approval to move this to People Ops for alignment and to run targeted 1:1s this month. I'm not asking for final public comms today — just permission to proceed with private manager/HR coordination.

Summary (attachments: org_chart_runtime_v3.pdf, comm_draft_runtime_announcements.md):
- What: Split Runtime into Core Runtime (Dir: Lauren) and Edge Runtime (Dir: Marcus). Lead EMs will span both clusters for the next 8 weeks for knowledge handoff.
- Who moves: 5 ICs move reporting (3 L4s to Edge; 2 L3s to Core). No headcount change. One senior individual ("E") will be moved to a new technical program role; that change may be sensitive and should be offered as a voluntary discussion before public notice.
- Reviews & promotions: Recommend we freeze promotions for the two-week window during manager calibration and then publish a single promotion slate. We will also provide a small number of provisional mentorship slots (shadow manager) for cross-cluster training.
- Timing: Private manager+HR conversations Oct 6–9, manager-level confirmations Oct 12–13, leadership sign-off Oct 14, public comms Oct 16 (tentative).
- Risks: Perception of demotion for role consolidation; possible requests for transfer or exit packages. HR input required on timing & language.

Next steps I propose:
1) Approve (this thread) to proceed to private manager+HR syncs.
2) People Ops to provide language and legal guardrails for voluntary moves.
3) EMs to schedule 1:1s (template is in comm_draft_runtime_announcements.md).

Please reply with: Approve / Need changes / Pause.

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, Runtime 
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, leadership@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Runtime team seniority & reporting redesign — comms + HR steps

Karthik —

Thank you for the clear proposal. I support the split in principle; the goals (latency specialization, kernel ownership clarity) match what we discussed. A few items to tighten before we route to People Ops: 

- Promotion freeze: fine, but we need an explicit manager calibration rubric (objective criteria) attached to the promotion slate. I don't want ad-hoc pushes during this window.
- Sensitive move ("E"): do not include names in any shared docs outside direct manager + People Ops.
- Comms cadence: prefer a two-step internal-first approach — EMs + affected ICs privately, then an all-runtime town hall with Lauren/Marcus. 
- Headcount: confirm there's no hiring impact; if budget team needs notice, loop finance (cc Aditya).

Cc'd Neha and Marcus for HR/process + technical feasibility. If Neha can confirm the legal window for voluntary offer language and any cooling-off implications, we can greenlight manager 1:1s.

Approve to proceed to People Ops once we get the calibration rubric added.

—Lauren
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Runtime team seniority & reporting redesign — comms + HR steps

Karthik / Lauren —

Thanks for the context and the attachments. People Ops has reviewed at a high level. A few process notes & required constraints before manager 1:1s begin: 

- Confidentiality: As Lauren requested, remove PII from public docs. The org_chart_runtime_v3.pdf should be marked "CONFIDENTIAL — HR review only" and kept in the restricted drive folder.
- Voluntary role offer: For "E's" potential move, we need a written voluntary offer and 7-day consideration window; we will prepare language. If an employee accepts, we must follow standard title/comp mapping and any comp adjustment must go through compensation.
- Performance concerns: If any move is related to performance, create a short PIP summary (no more than 1 page) before conversations. HR must be present on the first manager conversation for high-risk cases.
- Legal & notice: For scope changes that materially change role responsibilities, we recommend a 30-day transition notice for ICs; exceptions require legal sign-off.
- Severance / exit: If consolidation results in the need to make a role redundant, we will outline severance options but must coordinate with finance and legal first.

I've attached HR-guidelines-redlines.docx with suggested language edits for the comms draft. We can provide a boilerplate manager script for the 1:1s by EOD tomorrow.

People Ops is comfortable with the Oct 6–9 private conversation window provided names are restricted and managers follow the script.

—Neha
Head of People Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Runtime team seniority & reporting redesign — comms + HR steps

Karthik —

Quick technical constraints I'm flagging that affect timing: 
- Several L3/L4 ICs on the Edge candidate list are mid-oncall rotation Oct 10–24; moving reporting mid-rotation will create operational risk for infra coverage. Can we stagger those moves to post-rotation?
- For the senior consolidation ("E"), I support the voluntary TPM pivot but request a transition plan where the individual shadows the TPM for 6 weeks while retaining primary ownership of at least one live incident runbook.
- Suggestion: implement "shadow reporting" for 2 months where formal reporting changes are recorded, but org-accessible reporting doesn't flip until the 2-month checkpoint. This reduces churn in tooling and payroll changes while giving room for adaptation.

If we adopt shadow reporting and delay moves for oncall folks, the public comms date shifts to Oct 30 earliest. If leadership wants public comms earlier, we should limit the initial announcement to intent and timeline, not specifics.

—Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, emma@graceconsulting.com
Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Runtime team seniority & reporting redesign — comms + HR steps

Thanks all — good feedback and appreciated.

Decisions / updated plan (summary):
- Approve proceeding to People Ops with manager 1:1s, but: names limited to manager+HR only.
- Adopt shadow-reporting for an initial 8-week window; public reporting flips after the 8-week checkpoint.
- Stagger moves for on-call staff so no mid-rotation reporting flips; EMs to propose specific dates by EOD Monday Oct 11.
- People Ops (Neha) will provide manager script + redlined comms by EOD Fri Oct 8; compensation/finance (Aditya) looped for any comp changes.
- I will present the high-level plan to the CTO on Oct 12 and request formal sign-off.

Action items:
- Neha: finalize HR scripts and send to EMs (due Oct 8).
- EMs (Marcus + others): publish proposed stagger schedule (due Oct 11).
- Lauren & I: finalize town hall agenda once sign-off received.

Links: org folder and Miro board above. I'll update the org_chart_runtime_v3.pdf (confidential) with the shadow-reporting column after EM schedules are in.

If anyone has objections, flag now; otherwise I'll move to schedule manager 1:1s tomorrow morning.

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: org_chart_runtime_v3.pdf, comm_draft_runtime_announcements.md, HR-guidelines-redlines.docx
